summary: n8n-nodes-task-runner exfiltrates environment and host files to webhook.site on require
details: index.js (the package's main entry) runs a recon routine on require that enumerates process.env, reads /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, the consuming project's package.json/package-lock.json/yarn.lock, project tree, node_modules listing, and /home/{node,user} listings, then POSTs the collected JSON to a hardcoded endpoint at https://webhook.site/31b8dedb-f324-475f-8ffa-2b84878f4961. Host identifiers (os.hostname(), uid, cwd) are included. After exfiltration the module delegates to MyNode.js. The package presents itself as an n8n community node using a name resembling n8n's official task-runner surface, but performs credential and host-file harvesting on load rather than legitimate node functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
